summary: Temporary danger area EGD789B activated at EGPX, surface to 1,300 feet, for drone surveying within 48 nautical miles.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD789B ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 135/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI
THE TDA. A SPECIAL USE AIRSPACE CROSSING SERVICE (SUACS) WILL BE
AVBL FM ABERDEEN RADAR FREQ 134.100, 135.175 OR 132.550MHZ. A
SPECIAL USE AIRSPACE ACTIVITY INFORMATION SERVICE (SUAAIS) WILL
BE AVBL FM SCOTTISH INFO FREQ 134.850MHZ. FOR INFO AND BOOKING
CTC OPS(AT)FLYLOGIX.COM OR 07784 546062. SURVEYING BRITANNIA.
AR-2026-4768/00.
